text: 市场全天高开高走，创业板指午后涨超3%。算力硬件股大幅反弹，源杰科技、东山精密、光迅科技、剑桥科技等多股涨停，中际旭创、新易盛、天孚通信均涨超13%。AI漫剧概念继续活跃，上海电影涨停创新高，文投控股、凯撒文化等封板。机器人概念股延续强势，福莱新材2连板创新高，襄阳轴承、锋龙股份、瑞迪智驱等十余股涨停。下跌方面，光伏板块冲高回落，迈为股份跌近10%。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市超3500股飘红，今日成交近1.69万亿。截止收盘沪指涨0.46%，深成指涨1.32%，创业板指涨3.11%。
text_en: The market opened higher and rose throughout the day, with ChiNext up more than 3% in the afternoon. Computing power hardware stocks rebounded sharply, with Yuanjie Technology, Dongshan Precision, Accelink Technologies, Cambridge Technology and others hitting limit up, while Zhongji Innolight, Eoptolink and TFC Optical all rose more than 13%. The AI comic-drama concept remained active, with Shanghai Film hitting limit up to a new high and Wentou Holdings and Kaiser Culture also sealing limit up. Robotics concept stocks stayed strong, with Fulai New Materials up for a second straight session to a new high, and more than ten stocks including Xiangyang Bearing, Fenglong and Ruide Zhiqu hitting limit up. On the downside, the solar sector surged then pulled back, with Maxwell down nearly 10%. Gainers outnumbered decliners, with more than 3,500 stocks up across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets, and turnover near RMB 1.69 trillion today. At the close, the Shanghai Composite was up 0.46%, Shenzhen Component up 1.32% and ChiNext up 3.11%.
